TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with sewer line replacement work being carried out by Delhi Jal Board (DJB) at Basant Lane, Paharganj Traffic Area, traffic movement will remain affected from the night of 26/27.12.2025 till 02.01.2026.

📍 STRETCH AFFECTED:
Basant Lane, Paharganj
-Closed for all vehicular traffic during the work period

📍 ADVISORY FOR COMMUTERS & VISITORS:
-Avoid Basant Lane during the said period
-Local commuters and visitors are advised to use alternate routes

📍 SUGGESTED ALTERNATE ROUTES:
-Panchkuian Road
-Chelmsford Road
-Main Market, Nehru Nagar, Paharganj

📍 GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS / PUBLIC APPEAL:
-Plan your journey in advance to avoid inconvenience and delays
-Follow traffic signage and directions of traffic police personnel deployed on site
-Park only at designated parking places and avoid roadside parking
-Extend cooperation as the work is being carried out in public interest to improve sewer infrastructure

📍 Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police official channels

#DPTrafficAdvisory

Lagos issues traffic advisory ahead of Eyo Festival

The Lagos State Government has issued a traffic advisory ahead of the Eyo Festival, cautioning motorists and commuters to expect road closures and heavy traffic around Lagos Island.

In a statement shared via its official Instagram handle, lagosstategovt, the government said the cultural festival, which celebrates Lagos’ rich heritage, is expected to significantly affect vehicular movement within and around the Island.
---
